name: HyperBoostX
en: Windows diagnostics and preview-first optimization, Safety Guard and recovery visibility. Published installer and SHA-256 evidence; no guaranteed FPS improvements.
idText: Diagnostik dan optimasi Windows dengan preview, Safety Guard dan visibilitas pemulihan. Installer dan bukti SHA-256 telah dirilis; tanpa jaminan peningkatan FPS.

name: HyperBoostX V3
en: Next-generation desktop utility: diagnostics, explicit approval, encrypted backup, rollback and CLI recovery. Final Stable is not claimed.
idText: Utilitas desktop generasi baru: diagnostik, persetujuan, backup terenkripsi, rollback dan CLI pemulihan. Belum diklaim Final Stable.

name: TopoSurvey
stack: Flutter, Dart, GitHub Actions, SemVer, CodeQL
en: Team scope: repository management, CI/CD, automated tests, versioning, APK build, checksum and releases. Flutter CI and CodeQL passed; not claiming sole authorship.
idText: Cakupan tim: manajemen repositori, CI/CD, tes otomatis, versioning, build APK, checksum dan rilis. Flutter CI dan CodeQL lulus; bukan klaim karya individu seluruhnya.
media: TopoSurvey official hero animation (not an app screenshot)

name: Skeleton Geospatial GIS
en: Interactive browser map with 10 sample routes, route selection and distance/duration estimates; MongoDB 2dsphere indexing and spatial query examples. Data is illustrative.
idText: Peta interaktif browser dengan 10 contoh rute, pemilihan rute dan estimasi jarak/durasi; indeks MongoDB 2dsphere dan contoh kueri spasial. Data bersifat ilustratif.

name: PBO II Learning Platform
stack: C#, ASP.NET Core MVC, EF Core, REST API, JavaScript
en: Learning site with 11 OOP chapters, practice projects, quizzes and local progress. Console, MVC and REST API exercises plus documented build and deployment.
idText: Situs belajar 11 bab OOP, praktikum, kuis dan progres lokal. Latihan console, MVC dan REST API serta dokumentasi build dan deployment.

name: AintSaint Website
stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, GitHub Pages
en: Static data-driven website with dynamic detail pages, content filtering and booking integration. Contact data requires verification.
idText: Website statis berbasis data dengan halaman detail dinamis, filter konten dan integrasi booking. Data kontak memerlukan verifikasi.
